attributes.docs: Startup up axis, z or y.
attributes.name: up-axis

attributes.docs: Canvas right-click policy: camera (default) or browser. Live edits win in time order; removal resets to camera. Invalid values warn and retain the current policy.
attributes.name: context-menu

attributes.docs: Permit a software WebGPU adapter for testing only; absent by default.
attributes.name: allow-fallback-adapter

events.docs: The viewer finished startup. Fires once per connection.
events.name: cinema-viewer-ready

events.docs: A startup or attribute warning that has no command.
events.name: cinema-viewer-warning

events.docs: The viewer failed after startup. Fires once and no catalog event follows.
events.name: cinema-viewer-failed

events.docs: A short, uncancelled bound right click in camera mode. Nonbubbling, noncomposed and noncancelable; positions are release canvas CSS pixels.
events.name: cinema-viewer-contextmenu

events.docs: Progress for the current source load; no model is published until completion.
events.name: model-load-progress

properties.docs: The validated device record, or null before startup.
properties.name: capabilities

properties.docs: Adapter record and the last failure.
properties.name: diagnostics

properties.docs: Warnings of the last recovery replay.
properties.name: recoveryWarnings

properties.docs: Base URL of the package files; set before connection.
properties.name: assetBase

properties.docs: Canvas right-click policy: camera cancels menus for bound chords; browser keeps native menus. Pre-connection assignment wins over the startup attribute; later valid edits win in time order. Invalid assignments throw InvalidValue.
properties.name: contextMenu
